claims: The St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 9-7 on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at Busch Stadium.
The game opened the 2026 MLB season.
The game featured an eight-run sixth inning.
Rookie JJ Wetherholt hit a home run in his MLB debut.
Matthew Liberatore started on the mound for the St. Louis Cardinals.
Alec Burleson hit a 432-foot two-run home run during an eight-run sixth inning.
Ryne Stanek earned a save in his Cardinals debut.
The ceremonial first pitch was thrown by David Eckstein, Gary Bennett, Brian Jordan, and Tom Pagnozzi.
David Eckstein is the 2006 World Series MVP.
According to Redbird Rants and YouTube, the St. Louis Cardinals entered the 2026 season with a focus on a "new-look" roster and youth.
